prompt_category.instructions: In which category is the prompt ?

criteria.translation: translating text from one human language to another: “Translate this from German to English.”
criteria.math: arithmetic, algebra, calculus, geometry, probability, statistics, mathematical proofs, etc.
criteria.trivia: factual/general-knowledge questions: ”Who won the 1954 World Cup?”
criteria.technicalSupport: Linux, SSH, networking, configuration, error messages, hardware, etc.
criteria.research: questions requiring gathering/combining information rather than retrieving one known fact.
criteria.currentInformation: inherently time-sensitive questions such as “What’s the latest Ubuntu version?”
criteria.reasoning: logic, deduction, planning, analysis, puzzles, and problems requiring multi-step reasoning.
criteria.dataAnalysis: interpreting tables, CSVs, statistics, logs, etc.
criteria.other: important as a fallback instead of forcing a bad classification.

prompt_complexity.instructions: How complex is it to answer the prompt ?
criteria: Easy: Even a small local open weight model can answer it correctly.
Medium: A sophisticated model (>=300B) can handle the prompt.
Hard: Only the latest and best frontier foundation model from anthropic or open ai can handle it.

sensitiveData.instructions: Estimates the probability that the prompt itself contains sensitive, confidential, private, secret, or security-relevant information.
